name: Perception
tagline: Modular synth studio, VST3 plug-in, and hardware synth factory.
description: Perception: unlimited modular routing, granular and spectral synthesis, mathematically proven DSP, VST3 plug-in hosting and export, and hardware synth profiles.

posts.title: Unlimited Signal Routing: Tapping Any Outlet Into Any Bus
posts.alt: Dark indigo modular synth patch bay with glowing orange signal cables and lavender modulation arcs
posts.summary: Why fixed channel strips choke sound design — and how Perception lets you tap internal module outlets straight into sidechained stereo buses.

posts.title: Mathematically Proven DSP: Machine-Checked Waveguides & FFTs
posts.alt: Precision dark indigo oscilloscope grid with cyan harmonic spectra and glowing orange traveling wave curves
posts.summary: From allpass unit magnitude to weighted overlap-add and antiderivative anti-aliasing: every core formula carries a Lean proof that fails if mutated.

posts.title: From Patch to Pedal: Perception as a Hardware Synth Factory
posts.alt: Matte dark-indigo desktop synthesizer hardware box with glowing orange rotary encoders and cyan OLED waveform display
posts.summary: Bind your modular patch to a typed hardware profile and run the exact same DSP engine on a dedicated Raspberry Pi 5 pedal or desktop synth.
